column3: The recovery case for one customer and one product, with the accounts linked, from day 90 to close.
A route the case can be on. Eight are entered when the route decision selects them; the deviation stage and the universal rules are always available.
A state the case reaches and does not leave. It marks an achievement, not work.
Work a bank officer does. The case puts it in a queue or the officer picks it up.
Work the customer, guarantor or heir does. The case waits on them.
Work an outside party does, such as a law firm, agency, buyer or valuer.
A point where a rule or an approver sets the route. The outcome selects the next sentry.
The task a stage starts from. One per stage.
A task reached by an event rather than chosen, such as a declined approval or a blocked listing.
One entry or exit criterion: the event it listens for, the condition that must hold, and the action it takes. Each sentry is one routing rule.
Data the case holds. Sentries read it to test their conditions.
The Workbench starts the task. No person starts it.
A person chooses whether to start the task. It has more than one way out.
The case puts the task in a queue for a named owner. The delegation of authority decides who.
Fired by a person's action or decision.
Carries a time limit; fires when the time is reached if nothing else has.
Fired by the Workbench or another system, with no time limit.
